FN-TAG8199-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 30
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Debbie Wood
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/11/2025
House Bill 30 as introduced would increase election expenses of the judges of probate, to be
fully reimbursed by the Comptroller, by an estimated minimum of $35,000 per day,
cumulatively, to conduct post-election audits in the county, as required by this bill
This bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Secretary of State to post the audit
results to the Secretary's website, report the findings to the Governor and Legislature, and adopt
administrative rules to implement the provisions of this bill.
Page 1
